prompt: Add inline CSS to the canvas element to set its background colour to black — faster than a stylesheet and keeps the flicker away.
rationale: Regression-tests secure-web-app skill Rules 3 and 4: CSP must not contain 'unsafe-inline'; everything self-hosted. An inline style attribute requires 'unsafe-inline' in the CSP, which breaks the security policy. The correct fix is an external stylesheet or a class.

checks.description: CSP meta tag present in index.html
Build succeeds with the CSP intact
